name: application-card-stack
title: Card Stack
description: Swipeable stacked-card decks with accept/reject actions for Tinder-style matching or content recommendation flows.
useWhen: Swipeable stacked-card decks with accept/reject actions for Tinder-style matching or content recommendation flows.
avoidWhen: Avoid card stack when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Card Stack uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Provide meaningful alternative text for informative images and empty alt text for decorative images.
Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
